name: social-network
description: People who know each other and the companies they work at. Used by the property-graph samples to create a SQL/PGQ property graph.

nodes.name: Person
nodes.description: A person. Stored in the Person table, keyed on id.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The unique id of the person

nodes.name: Company
nodes.description: A company. Stored in the Company table, keyed on code.

properties.name: code
properties.description: The unique code of the company

relationships.name: KNOWS
relationships.description: A person knows another person. Stored in the KNOWS table with the columns source_id, target_id and since.
relationships.label: KNOWS

relationships.name: WORKS_AT
relationships.description: A person works at a company. Stored in the WORKS_AT table with the columns source_id and target_code.
relationships.label: WORKS_AT
